project_type: TypeScript programming language suite (lexer, parser, interpreter, CLI, stdlib, REPL, playground)
build_system: npm + tsc (TypeScript compiler). Strict mode enabled with noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noImplicitReturns.
test_framework: Vitest with 124 passing tests across 4 test files (lexer, parser, interpreter, integration)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to compile. 2. Run npx vitest run to verify tests pass. 3. Run node dist/cli/index.js run examples/01-hello.tiny to verify CLI works. 4. Open playground/index.html in browser for web IDE.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js 22.x available via nvm. Bun 1.2.14 available. TypeScript strict mode requires all code to pass strict checks.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript throughout, Node.js 18+ compatible. Playground must work from a single HTML file or simple npm script. No external services required.
key_patterns: 1. AST nodes in src/types/ast.ts with SourcePosition on every node. 2. Runtime values in src/types/values.ts using discriminated unions. 3. Environment class with parent chain for scoping. 4. Stdlib registered via registerStdlib() with NativeFunctionValue objects. 5. Error classes: LexerError, ParseError, RuntimeError all carry position info. 6. CLI uses raw process.argv parsing. 7. Tests use vitest describe/it/expect pattern. 8. TinyLang class is the high-level API that orchestrates lexer->parser->interpreter.
directory_structure: src/ - source code (cli/, interpreter/, lexer/, parser/, repl/, stdlib/, types/, utils/). tests/ - vitest tests (integration/, interpreter/, lexer/, parser/). examples/ - 10 .tiny example programs. playground/ - web playground (single index.html). dist/ - compiled output. .kiro/ - specs, steering, hooks.
